acceptance_criteria: Email/parse parses all 5 body-value args; correct default property list used; tests with RFC spec examples
description: RFC 8621 §4.9 requires Email/parse to parse the same 5 body-value fetch arguments as Email/get (bodyProperties, fetchTextBodyValues, fetchHTMLBodyValues, fetchAllBodyValues, maxBodyValueBytes). Currently handle_email_parse (email.rs ~lines 1074–1135) only accepts blobIds and properties. Also, when 'properties' is null/omitted, must use the RFC 8621 §4.9 default list (messageId, inReplyTo, references, sender, from, to, cc, bcc, replyTo, subject, sentAt, hasAttachment, preview, bodyValues, textBody, htmlBody, attachments) — currently all properties returned. Both issues are in email.rs lines 1074–1135.
title: Email/parse: body-value fetch args + default property list
